title: Lift the load; inspect retained metal deformation
changes: Lift ball and Release lift apply bounded native forces. External work, impulse and torque are recorded; no teleport, assigned velocity or removed material.
A general object-acceleration command drives every dynamic cell using its material-derived mass. Invalid commands preserve the accepted scene and journal.
Unloaded iron retains its plastic rest/history and a downward central deformation. Settling, full contact accuracy and continuum yielding/tearing remain unqualified.
Default glass/oak/iron/ice physical/work results remain exact. Full five-goal completion is still open.
